scenes.text: A learner uses 3 equal handspans to measure. How many handspans were used? Let us think carefully. Count one unit each time: 3 handspans. The answer is 3. Great work!
A learner uses 4 equal cupfuls to measure. How many cupfuls were used? Let us think carefully. Count one unit each time: 4 cupfuls. The answer is 4. Great work!
A learner uses 5 equal paper strips to measure. How many paper strips were used? Let us think carefully. Count one unit each time: 5 paper strips. The answer is 5. Great work!
A learner uses 6 equal footsteps to measure. How many footsteps were used? Let us think carefully. Count one unit each time: 6 footsteps. The answer is 6. Great work!
